text.p: Western Samoa posted the fifth win of their 11-match British tour on Tuesday, crushing European Cup semifinalists Cardiff 53-29.
The Welsh club were overrun by technically superior and far more adventurous opponents who ran in seven tries.
Samoan skipper Pat Lam set the ball rolling with a 13th minute score under the posts. Wing Pailate Fili and full-back Veli Patu quickly followed suit as Cardiff fell 22-3 behind inside 30 minutes.
Centre Delme Williams offered hope to Cardiff when he powered over unopposed, but fly-half Earl Va'a resumed normal service with his second penalty five minutes after the restart.
Samoa left wing Afato So'oalo added three more tries and flanker Junior Paramore one.
